title: One soundness lemma per Opcode constructor, glued by a bare cases-dispatch
intent: Reduce the soundness of a single Cairo VM opcode step — that the output state is bounded and related to the input by NextState — to one named lemma per constructor of the Opcode inductive. The glue exec_step_sound is a bare cases o with one apply per constructor and no other proof work, so the decomposition is read straight off the Opcode type.

parent.name: exec_step_sound
parent.statement:
lemma exec_step_sound [Fact (Nat.Prime Stwo.P)] [Fact (Nat.Prime Felt252Prime)] {t n_s : ℕ}
      {o : Opcode}
      {v : VarAssign}
      -- memory
      {memAssign : Felt252IdMemoryAssign}
      {mem : Felt252 → Felt252}
      (h_mem_agrees : memAssign.Agrees mem)
      -- Lookups
      {h_satisfied : LookupsSatisfied t n_s NUM_PARTITIONS NUM_LOOKUP_REL_MINUS_ONE partition_lengths rel_partition chain_rels}
      -- opcode constraints
      (h_opcode_satisfied : (OpcodeAirFns o).1.SatisfiedBy v)
      -- Terms agree
      (h_lookup_terms_agree : (OpcodeAirFns o).2.1.UseAgree v h_satisfied.values h_satisfied.partitions h_satisfied.tuples)
      -- other relations
      (h_rc : RangeCheckYields h_satisfied.values (h_satisfied.tuples RANGE_CHECK_REL_INDEX))
      (h_mem : AirLookupTerms.MemYieldsAgreeAndRangeChecked memAssign h_satisfied.values
          (h_satisfied.tuples RANGE_CHECK_REL_INDEX)
          (h_satisfied.tuples MEMORY_ADDR_TO_ID_REL_INDEX)
          (h_satisfied.tuples MEMORY_ID_TO_VALUE_REL_INDEX))
      (h_verify_instr : AirLookupTerms.VerifyInstrYieldAgrees h_satisfied.tuples)
      (num_steps : Nat)
      (h_num_steps : num_steps < 2 ^ 29) :
      (OpcodeInStateVal (o, v)).strongly_bounded₀ num_steps →
        (OpcodeOutStateVal (o, v)).strongly_bounded (num_steps + 1)
          ∧ NextState mem (OpcodeInStateVal (o, v)).toRegisterStateFelt252 (OpcodeOutStateVal (o, v)).toRegisterStateFelt252

theorem sound_generic [Fact (Nat.Prime Stwo.P)] [Fact (Nat.Prime Felt252Prime)] {t n_s : Nat}
      (varAssign : VarAssign)
      {memAssign : Felt252IdMemoryAssign}
      {mem : Felt252 → Felt252}
      (h_mem_agrees : memAssign.Agrees mem)
      (ab : AirBuilder)
      (lt : AirLookupTerms)
      {h_satisfied : LookupsSatisfied t n_s NUM_PARTITIONS NUM_LOOKUP_REL_MINUS_ONE partition_lengths rel_partition chain_rels}
      (h_rc : RangeCheckYields h_satisfied.values (h_satisfied.tuples RANGE_CHECK_REL_INDEX))
      (h_mem : AirLookupTerms.MemYieldsAgreeAndRangeChecked memAssign h_satisfied.values
            (h_satisfied.tuples RANGE_CHECK_REL_INDEX)
            (h_satisfied.tuples MEMORY_ADDR_TO_ID_REL_INDEX)
            (h_satisfied.tuples MEMORY_ID_TO_VALUE_REL_INDEX))
      (h_verify_instr : AirLookupTerms.VerifyInstrYieldAgrees h_satisfied.tuples)
      {casmState : CasmState}
      {num_steps: Nat} :
    let ⟨new_ab, new_lt, ρCasmState⟩ := call ab lt casmState
    num_steps < 2^29 →
    (casmState.eval varAssign).strongly_bounded₀ num_steps →
    new_ab.SatisfiedBy varAssign →

      (ρCasmState.eval varAssign).strongly_bounded (num_steps+1) ∧
      NextState mem (casmState.eval varAssign).toRegisterStateFelt252 (ρCasmState.eval varAssign).toRegisterStateFelt252

applicability.goal_shape: A goal parameterised by a finite inductive type (here Opcode, 19 constructors) whose claim must hold for every constructor; here the claim is (OpcodeInStateVal (o, v)).strongly_bounded₀ num_steps → (OpcodeOutStateVal (o, v)).strongly_bounded (num_steps+1) ∧ NextState mem …, i.e. one step of the opcode is bounded and matches NextState.
applicability.use_when: the target is a finite inductive/enumeration and each constructor already has a pre-written lemma of exactly the goal's shape (here one sound_X per constructor, all sharing the identical statement template); the glue is then a cases plus one apply per constructor, and exhaustiveness is discharged by the type's totality.
applicability.avoid_when: the constructors do not share one statement template, so each case needs a different argument rather than a bare apply; or the per-constructor lemmas do not exist yet (the cost is N proofs, one per constructor); or the glue must do real work besides dispatching, such as rearranging hypotheses per case.

consequences: One lemma per Opcode constructor, so the obligations are: (1) exhaustiveness — every constructor must be covered, which cases o discharges by the type's totality (19/19 constructors, no separate exhaustiveness child); (2) each constructor's lemma must have exactly the goal's shape (strongly_bounded₀ num_steps → strongly_bounded (num_steps+1) ∧ NextState after the opcode's call), or the bare apply will not match; (3) adding a constructor to Opcode forces a new sound_X lemma and a new case, so the decomposition is coupled to the opcode set. Failure mode: the 19 lemmas are near-identical templates, so a change to the shared sound_auto/spec infrastructure breaks the whole family at once.
